_comment: Liveness for the GitHub accounts that reach this site through the hand-transcribed dossier files. scripts/enrich-github-accounts.js only ever reads src/_data/iocs/scraped-iocs.json, so these had no status at all; scripts/lib/dossiers.js attaches this file to them at build time, exactly as it attaches linkedin-account-status.json to the LinkedIn accounts. It covers every dossier login, including those the scraper also holds, because src/_data/iocs/iocIndex.js lets the dossier group claim an id first — so for a shared login it is the dossier record that renders, and without an entry here it rendered with no status. `account_id` is GitHub's numeric id, read from the redirect github.com/<login>.png issues, and it is recorded because GitHub frees a deleted account's login for anyone to re-register: without it a recycled handle answers 200, reads as live, and this site would present whoever holds it now as the account a researcher named. A `recycled` entry carries the date the present account was created and the date the identifier was first published, so the page can state the gap, and never carries an avatar.
